title: Algorithmic nudge: Using XAI frameworks to design interventions
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze or measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on using Explainable AI (XAI) frameworks to design interventions against problematic content, with examples related to political misinformation and conspiracy theories.
